housekeeping.value: TBD (> 0 for an active pre-ionizer controller)

differential.V1_preionizer_after_discharge: start-up phases identical across the three architectures up to keeper-off; the pre-ionizer adds P_bus[source] (+ P_bus[ecr_magnet]) only in the steady (keeper-off) mode, so the start-up differential before steady is 0 W
differential.V2_preionizer_seed_before_discharge: during cathode/discharge ignition the pre-ionized arms add P_bus[source] (+ P_bus[ecr_magnet]) on top of the phase load; with the heater still on the start-up peak of rf_hall/ecr_hall exceeds the hall_only level by that source bus draw (lane 19 Sec. 7)

peak_limit.note: interpretation that the RFP '< 1.5 kW' also bounds start-up transients; the owner confirms or replaces it

cathode_ignition.from: cathode_heater + cathode_keeper brackets (+ flow_control, housekeeping >= 0); the brackets come from different cathodes, so the sum is a bracket, not a design

phase_order.note: heater raises the emitter to emission temperature
cathode Xe flow on, keeper voltage applied, keeper current regulated
heater off once the discharge starts; anode supply on
keeper off/floating once the anode current is nominal, unless the discharge current is below the cathode's self-heating current

startup.phase_order_status: phase order sourced (Goebel & Katz Sec. 7.2.3 p. 337; IEPC-2017-276 pp. 3-4; IEPC-2015-43 p. 4); powers and durations are inputs
startup.startup_ledger: NOT_EVALUABLE (see ledgers): hall_discharge ignition load, supply efficiencies, housekeeping TBD; abep_sim.cathode_integration.startup_transient is the function to use once they exist

ecr_hall.V1_preionizer_after_discharge: hall_only sequence, then ecr_magnet, then ecr_source
ecr_hall.V2_preionizer_seed_before_discharge: ecr_magnet and ecr_source on before discharge_ignition (seed hypothesis)

rf_hall.V1_preionizer_after_discharge: hall_only sequence, then rf_source on after keeper_off: the heater never overlaps the pre-ionizer
rf_hall.V2_preionizer_seed_before_discharge: rf_source on during cathode_ignition/discharge_ignition (seed hypothesis): check the peak against the bus limit when the heater is still on
